title: Raw git test fixtures flake in CI when git's detached maintenance writes after the test ends; 131 files still build one
summary: From git 2.47 a commit detaches `git maintenance run --auto`, which can keep writing in .git/objects after the test returned, so t.TempDir's RemoveAll fails with `unlinkat ...: directory not empty`. gittest.Fixture persists maintenance.auto=false and gc.auto=0 and retries teardown, but raw `git init` fixtures do neither. The class has now failed CI three times: the dossier fixture twice, then internal/core's shipped-lane fixture on PR #698 (TestUnwindShipCommit_DeclinesWithoutMovingHEAD/a_consumed_copy_under_another_name, run 36427299523), a change that touched neither. The raw-git ratchet stops new sites, but 131 test files (183 init sites) remain in its baseline.
fix: Migrate the remaining fixtures to gittest.Fixture / gittest.Bare / gittest.Clone, package by package, highest CI traffic first (internal/core, internal/phases/ship, internal/phases/audit, cmd/evolve), dropping or lowering each baseline.json entry as its sites go. Behaviour-preserving: a fixture whose layout needs its worktree inside a project root keeps the root as a separate TempDir.
acceptance: Each migrated file's baseline.json entry is removed or lowered, and TestRatchet_NoNewRawGitFixtures passes
The migrated packages' tests pass under go test -count=1
No test in a migrated package fails with a TempDir RemoveAll `directory not empty` error in CI
source: console, 2026-09-28, CI failure on PR #698 classified as the raw-fixture flake class (third occurrence)
